workflow.name: YouTube thumbnails
workflow.description: From a video title and an optional face or product image URL, renders 3 high-contrast 16:9 thumbnail concepts with fal.ai FLUX and recommends the best one. The PNGs land in Artifacts.

inputs.name: image_url
inputs.label: Face or product image URL (optional, public https link)

nodes.label: Plan 3 concepts
Render with fal
nodes.prompt:
Render the 3 thumbnail concepts below with the fal.ai REST API. Generate exactly 3 images in total, one per concept (num_images 1); do not retry more than once per concept.

Read the key from the FAL_KEY environment variable with curl and headers `Authorization: Key $FAL_KEY` and `Content-Type: application/json`; never print or echo it. If FAL_KEY is not set, stop and say: add FAL_KEY in Hive › Keys.

Reference image URL: "{{inputs.image_url}}"

- If the reference image URL above is empty: POST https://fal.run/fal-ai/flux/dev with JSON {"prompt": <concept prompt>, "image_size": "landscape_16_9", "num_images": 1, "output_format": "png"}. Model: FLUX.1 [dev].
- If it is set: POST https://fal.run/fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext with JSON {"prompt": <concept prompt, phrased as an edit that keeps the person or product from the reference>, "image_url": <the reference URL>, "aspect_ratio": "16:9", "num_images": 1, "output_format": "png"}. Model: FLUX.1 Kontext [pro].

Both endpoints are synchronous on fal.run and return {"images":[{"url":...}]}. Download each images[0].url (curl -sfL) into "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/thumbnail-1.png", "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/thumbnail-2.png" and "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/thumbnail-3.png" (in concept order).

Reply with, per concept: the saved path, the model used, the overlay text and the exact prompt sent. Note any concept that failed and why.

Concepts:
{{concepts.output}}

nodes.label: Recommend the best
nodes.prompt:
Open and look at each saved thumbnail in "$ARTIFACTS_DIR" (thumbnail-1.png to thumbnail-3.png). Score each 1-5 on: readability at small size, contrast, focal clarity, text legibility (is the overlay text spelled correctly?), and fit with the title "{{inputs.title}}". Recommend one winner and give one concrete tweak for it.

Then write a short "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/README.md" with: the video title, a table listing each file, concept name, model and overlay text, the exact prompt used for each image, the scores, and the recommendation. Do not include any API keys.

Reply with the winning file path and a two-line rationale.

Render report:
{{render.output}}
